intro: Having brought Lotwil Veriatus the Frost Oil from Coolant Heads Prevail, you find Lotwil still absorbed in a contraption in the Badlands. One small but crucial part is missing: a gyrochronatom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you've done your job well beyond all standards.
If we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work.
Whoops! Quick, grab the... Yes, that. Thanks.
Now I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom.
If you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, yes, yes. Just a moment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perfect... Just about done. No, really. I AM almost done now. This project is my top priority... At the moment. Let me pop this into place, and you can see for yourself what you've helped me create. It'll just take me a few more minutes... Maybe... Possibly longer. Well, maybe a lot longer. We'll see...
